opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest option
opportunities.description: On booking.com Flights, search for a one-way or multi-city flight from {origin} to {destination} on {departure_date} (plus optional extra legs), sort by Fastest, and move forward with the top flight.
steps: Open the Flights tab
Type {origin} in 'Where from?' and pick the suggestion
Type {destination} in 'Where to?' and pick the suggestion
Optionally switch to Multi-city and add each extra leg ({leg_origin}, {leg_destination}, {leg_date})
Open the departure date picker, choose {departure_date}, and adjust travellers if needed
Click Search
Sort by Fastest
Click 'See flight' on the top result, then Select
Choose a fare/option and click Next

instances.values: Bangalore → Goa, depart 29 Mar 2023, one-way, sorted by Fastest
Multi-city: New York → Tokyo on 1 Jun 2023, then Tokyo (TYO) → New Delhi (DEL) on 5 Jun 2023, sorted by Fastest

opportunities.name: Expedia car rental search
opportunities.description: On Expedia Cars, search for rental cars at {pickup_location} (same drop-off) from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date}, with optional pick-up/drop-off times, apply filters, and sort the results.
steps: Click the Cars tab
Type {pickup_location} in Pick-up and pick the suggestion
Optionally set the drop-off location (same as pick-up)
Open the date picker, choose {pickup_date} and {dropoff_date}, then click Done
Optionally pick {pickup_time} and {dropoff_time}
Click Search
Tick the filter checkboxes you want
Optionally set 'Sort by' to {sort_order}

instances.values: JFK pick-up and drop-off, Apr 3–6 2023, 9:00 am – 6:00 pm, 2 filters, sorted by Total Price (interrupted by other browsing)
San Francisco, CA, through Apr 8 2023, 2 filters

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: On Carnival, search for cruises by {destination}, optional {departure_port} and {month}, and set the number of guests.
steps: Open 'Sail To' and pick {destination}
Optionally open 'Sail From' and pick {departure_port}
Optionally open 'Dates' and pick {month}
Click SEARCH CRUISES
Open 'Number of Guests' and adjust it to {guests}
Close the panel to apply

instances.values: Panama Canal from San Francisco, CA, October 2024
Caribbean, guests raised to 4 (interrupted by Kohl's browsing)

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search for airport parking at {airport} for {start_date}–{end_date} and sort the results.
steps: Click the Airport tab
Type {airport} in 'Airport Name, Code or City' and pick the suggestion
Open Parking Start Date and choose {start_date} and {end_date}
Optionally change the sort dropdown to {sort_order}

instances.values: JFK, Apr 18–20 2023, sorted by Shuttle Time
Dallas Love Field (DAL); dates were not set in the trace

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, open Planned Work / Service Changes, search for {route}, and optionally choose {date} to see planned service changes.
steps: Open the Planned Work / Planned Service Changes page
Type {route} in 'Search Routes' and pick it from the list
Optionally open the date picker, go to the right month, and choose {date}
